title: 第15章 闭关冲击气入三层第16章 齐聚演武考核开启
slug: 凡人修仙开局觉醒寂灭道体
lines: 晨光渐盛，后山林间雾气缓缓散去。
青岚宗杂役院依旧人声涌动，无数弟子围着公示石壁驻足观望。
有人摩拳擦掌，立志要闯考核入外门。
有人黯然神伤，修为不足只能眼睁睁看着机缘擦肩而过。
整个后山都因三日后的外门考核陷入躁动不安之中。
唯有偏僻角落的这间破旧木屋，与世隔绝，静得落针可闻。
林宸紧闭门窗，端坐木床之上，心神完全沉淀。
周遭所有的喧嚣议论、人心浮躁，都无法扰乱他分毫道心。
连日苦修沉淀，他的炼气二层早已打磨到极致圆满。
丹田灵力凝练厚重，经脉宽阔通畅，肉身筋骨被灵气常年滋养，坚韧远超同阶修士。
如今外门考核时日已定，再没必要刻意压制境界。
正好借着这三日空闲，顺势冲破桎梏，稳稳踏入炼气三层。
低层境界一层一夯实，一层一沉淀，从不贪进，从不虚浮。
这是他重生归来恪守的修行准则。
双目轻闭，呼吸悠长匀净。
林宸缓缓运转宗门基础吐纳心法，引动天地间游离的灵气。
木屋四周的灵气悄然汇聚，顺着周身毛孔源源不断渗入体内。
寂灭道体依旧被凡尘浊气封藏，不显任何神异异象。
只凭天生灵气亲和优势，纳气速度精纯迅猛，远非普通杂役所能想象。
灵气入体，循经脉流转大周天，最终尽数汇入丹田气海。
原本已经饱和的灵力，开始层层叠加、凝练压缩。
积蓄到极致之后，开始朝着炼气二层与三层之间的境界壁垒，发起温和而沉稳的冲击。
寻常杂役弟子破境，大多心绪浮躁，急于求成。
要么灵力掌控不稳，冲垮经脉留下暗伤；
要么根基浅薄，卡在瓶颈久久无法寸进。
可这些问题，在林宸身上根本不存在。
他拥有前世漫长修行阅历，对每一层境界的突破火候、灵气把控，都拿捏得炉火纯青。
每一次灵力冲击都恰到好处，不急不躁，以水磨之势慢慢磨开境界屏障。
时间一点点流逝，屋外日头缓缓移过中天。
杂役院的喧闹依旧此起彼伏，不少弟子已经无心劳作，纷纷回屋闭门苦修，想要临时抱佛脚，冲刺修为门槛。
赵虎便是其中之一。
回到自己木屋之后，便立刻闭关不出，拼命压榨体内灵力，想要稳固炼气三层修为，为日后擂台对战增添底气。
还有几名杂役院里修为不俗的弟子，也全都选择闭门潜修，暗中蓄力。
content_en:
The morning light is getting stronger, and the mist in the forest behind the mountain slowly dissipates.
The Qinglan Sect's Miscellaneous Courtyard was still crowded with people, and countless disciples gathered around the stone wall to watch.
Some people are gearing up and determined to pass the examination and enter the outer gate.
Some people feel dejected and have insufficient cultivation and can only watch opportunities pass by.
The entire back mountain was in a state of restlessness due to the external examination that was scheduled to take place three days later.
Only this dilapidated wooden house in a remote corner is isolated from the world and so quiet that you can hear a pin drop.
Lin Chen closed the doors and windows tightly, sat upright on the wooden bed, and his mind was completely calm.
All the noisy discussions and impetuous people around him could not disturb his Taoist heart in the slightest.
After days of hard training, his second level of Qi Refining has been polished to perfection.
The spiritual power of the Dantian is concentrated and thick, the meridians are wide and smooth, and the muscles and bones of the physical body are nourished by the spiritual energy all year round. The toughness far exceeds that of monks of the same level.
Now that the time for the outer sect assessment has been set, there is no need to deliberately suppress the realm.
I just took advantage of these three days of free time to break through the shackles and steadily enter the third level of Qi refining.
The low-level realm is consolidated layer by layer and settled layer by layer. It is never greedy for progress and never vain.
This is the practice principle he abides by after his rebirth.
Close your eyes lightly and breathe long and evenly.
Lin Chen slowly operated the sect's basic breathing method, activating the free spiritual energy between heaven and earth.
The spiritual energy around the wooden house quietly gathered and penetrated into the body along the pores of the whole body.
The body of Nirvana is still sealed by the turbid air of the mortal world, and does not show any supernatural phenomena.
Just relying on the natural affinity advantage of spiritual energy, the speed of receiving energy is pure and fast, which is far beyond the imagination of ordinary handymen.
The spiritual energy enters the body, flows along the meridians and circulates throughout the Great Circumference, and finally merges into the sea of ​​energy in the Dantian.
The originally saturated spiritual power began to be layered, condensed and compressed.
After accumulating to the extreme, he began to launch a gentle and steady attack towards the realm barrier between the second and third levels of Qi Refining.
When ordinary handyman disciples break through, most of them are impetuous and eager for success.
Either the control of spiritual power is unstable, overwhelming the meridians and leaving hidden injuries;
Either the foundation is shallow and stuck in a bottleneck for a long time, unable to make any progress.
But these problems did not exist for Lin Chen at all.
He has a long experience of practicing in his previous life, and he is very good at breaking through the fire and controlling the spiritual energy of each level.
Every spiritual impact is just right, not impatient or impetuous, slowly grinding away the realm barrier with the force of a water mill.
Time passed little by little, and the sun outside the house slowly moved across the sky.
The hustle and bustle in the mess hall is still going on. Many disciples have no intention of working anymore and have gone back to their houses to practice hard in a closed door, hoping to cram in and rush towards the threshold of cultivation.
Zhao Hu is one of them.
After returning to his wooden house, he immediately retreated into seclusion, desperately squeezing the spiritual power in his body, hoping to stabilize the third level of Qi refining and gain confidence for future battles in the ring.
There are also several disciples with good cultivation in the courtyard, who all choose to practice behind closed doors and secretly accumulate strength.
